remarks: Discover the perfect blend of comfort & convenience in this beautifully renovated 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home. Go inside to find stunning wood floors throughout & an abundance of natural light that creates a warm & inviting atmosphere. The spacious living room, complete w/ a charming fireplace & built-in shelving on either side, is perfect for showcasing your favorite treasures & enjoying cozy evenings. The large eat-in kitchen is designed for family-style entertaining, offering plenty of room for cooking and gathering w/ loved ones. Please, NO PETS though. Go outside to relax on the covered patio, an ideal spot for enjoying your morning coffee or hosting outdoor dinners. Nestled near Bible Street Playground, Cos Cob's charming shops, and top-rated schools, this home combines comfort w/ unbeatable location.
